I'm Dr. Ryan Gleeson — chiropractor, founder of Gorilla Chiropractic in Perth, Australia, and builder of chiropractors who refuse to stay stuck.

My chiro journey started as a lean solo operation. Then, in 2017, I went bankrupt. I rebuilt into a multimillion-dollar clinic and now I'm off the tools, scaling Gorilla Chiro and developing leaders.

I know how little guidance chiropractors have and how they want more impact, volume, income, and life.

So, I built a methodology that helps chiros not just clinically, but through systems, mindset, self-awareness, and belief structures.

My mission is to develop the profession — to build chiropractors who aren't your typical conventional doctor, who serve with impact, make great money, and live great lives.

Some things to know:
- Combined 400k following across platforms
- Brazilian jiu-jitsu brown belt
- Worked with world champions
- Trained with some of the best coaches

New videos weekly on what no one else in chiropractic is teaching.
